text: Hope is the thing with feathers that perches in the soul.
Keep your face always toward the sunshine, and shadows will fall behind you.
Even the darkest night will end and the sun will rise.
Once you choose hope, anything's possible.
There is always light, if only we're brave enough to see it. If only we're brave enough to be it.
The sun himself is weak when he first rises, and gathers strength and courage as the day gets on.
No winter lasts forever; no spring skips its turn.
Where there is love there is life.
We must accept finite disappointment, but never lose infinite hope.
Hope is being able to see that there is light despite all of the darkness.
Every day may not be good, but there is something good in every day.
It's always darkest before the dawn.
Tomorrow is a new day with no mistakes in it yet.
In the middle of every difficulty lies opportunity.
The best is yet to be.
You gain strength, courage, and confidence by every experience in which you really stop to look fear in the face.
Courage doesn't always roar. Sometimes courage is the quiet voice at the end of the day saying, "I will try again tomorrow."
Life shrinks or expands in proportion to one's courage.
It always seems impossible until it's done.
Do one thing every day that scares you.
You are braver than you believe, stronger than you seem, and smarter than you think.
Fall seven times, stand up eight.
The cave you fear to enter holds the treasure you seek.
Courage is grace under pressure.
Vulnerability is the birthplace of innovation, creativity and change.
What would life be if we had no courage to attempt anything?
You can't cross the sea merely by standing and staring at the water.
Be bold, and mighty forces will come to your aid.
I am not afraid of storms, for I am learning how to sail my ship.
No act of kindness, no matter how small, is ever wasted.
Be kind, for everyone you meet is fighting a hard battle.
Kindness is the language which the deaf can hear and the blind can see.
How lovely to think that no one need wait a moment; we can start now, start slowly, changing the world.
Wherever there is a human being, there is an opportunity for a kindness.
Carry out a random act of kindness, with no expectation of reward.
You cannot do a kindness too soon, for you never know how soon it will be too late.
Too often we underestimate the power of a touch, a smile, a kind word, a listening ear.
Be the reason someone smiles today.
In a world where you can be anything, be kind.
Talk to yourself like you would to someone you love.
We rise by lifting others.
If you want others to be happy, practice compassion. If you want to be happy, practice compassion.
Kind words can be short and easy to speak, but their echoes are truly endless.
The best time to plant a tree was twenty years ago. The second best time is now.
It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
The man who moves a mountain begins by carrying away small stones.
Live as if you were to die tomorrow. Learn as if you were to live forever.
I am always doing that which I cannot do, in order that I may learn how to do it.
Not all those who wander are lost.
What we plant in the soil of contemplation, we shall reap in the harvest of action.
You don't have to see the whole staircase, just take the first step.
Be not afraid of growing slowly; be afraid only of standing still.
A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
The more that you read, the more things you will know. The more that you learn, the more places you'll go.
Mistakes are proof that you are trying.
Growth is painful. Change is painful. But nothing is as painful as staying stuck somewhere you don't belong.
Little by little, one travels far.
Almost everything will work again if you unplug it for a few minutes, including you.
Nature does not hurry, yet everything is accomplished.
Within you, there is a stillness and a sanctuary to which you can retreat at any time.
You should sit in meditation for twenty minutes a day, unless you're too busy; then you should sit for an hour.
Peace comes from within. Do not seek it without.
Feelings come and go like clouds in a windy sky. Conscious breathing is my anchor.
Do not anticipate trouble, or worry about what may never happen. Keep in the sunlight.
The present moment is filled with joy and happiness. If you are attentive, you will see it.
You have power over your mind, not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
Smile, breathe and go slowly.
We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
Muddy water is best cleared by leaving it alone.
Calm mind brings inner strength and self-confidence.
For fast-acting relief, try slowing down.
Joy is not in things; it is in us.
The most wasted of all days is one without laughter.
Find ecstasy in life; the mere sense of living is joy enough.
Let us be grateful to the people who make us happy; they are the charming gardeners who make our souls blossom.
Happiness is not something ready made. It comes from your own actions.
I would rather have roses on my table than diamonds on my neck.
Joy is the simplest form of gratitude.
If you have a garden and a library, you have everything you need.
Folks are usually about as happy as they make up their minds to be.
Some days are just bad days, that's all. You have to experience sadness to know happiness.
Today you are You, that is truer than true. There is no one alive who is Youer than You.
Laughter is timeless, imagination has no age, and dreams are forever.
Enjoy the little things, for one day you may look back and realize they were the big things.
Happiness can be found even in the darkest of times, if one only remembers to turn on the light.
The world is full of magic things, patiently waiting for our senses to grow sharper.
Look up at the stars and not down at your feet.
To see a world in a grain of sand and a heaven in a wild flower.
The most beautiful thing we can experience is the mysterious.
Wonder is the beginning of wisdom.
Somewhere, something incredible is waiting to be known.
Look deep into nature, and then you will understand everything better.
I have loved the stars too fondly to be fearful of the night.
Not knowing where I'm going is what inspires me to travel.
We are all in the gutter, but some of us are looking at the stars.
In every walk with nature one receives far more than he seeks.
The universe is under no obligation to make sense to you.
There are always flowers for those who want to see them.
Imagination is the only weapon in the war against reality.
Rest is not idleness, and to lie sometimes on the grass under trees on a summer's day is by no means a waste of time.
Sometimes the most productive thing you can do is relax.
Take rest; a field that has rested gives a bountiful crop.
Your calm mind is the ultimate weapon against your challenges. So relax.
There is virtue in work and there is virtue in rest. Use both and overlook neither.
Tension is who you think you should be. Relaxation is who you are.
Sleep is the best meditation.
You can't pour from an empty cup. Take care of yourself first.
Doing nothing is very hard to do. You never know when you're finished.
Learn to rest, not to quit.
And if tonight my soul may find her peace in sleep, and sink in good oblivion, I shall be content.
